changes.comment: FsFileTreeAccessors and FileTree.forFilesystem accept IFsFileTreeInitParams with an absolutePathPolicy ('unconfined', the default and unchanged behaviour; 'confined', which maps a path outside the prefix beneath it; 'verified', which fails any operation outside the prefix) and realPath (refuse a symbolic link that leads outside, on by default under 'verified'), applied to every read, listing, stat and write; asking for either without a prefix fails creation; adds FsFileTreeAccessors.create, FsAbsolutePathPolicy and allFsAbsolutePathPolicies, and corrects the prefix documentation
